title: Custom Commands
summary: Slash commands you define per server — send a message, reply, or trigger built-ins — plus NEXORIA's own built-in commands like /status.

sections.heading: Creating a command
sections.body: Each custom command gets its own name, description, and one or more actions (currently: send a message). Type { in a message field to insert a variable, or type one out yourself.

sections.heading: Variables
sections.body: Resolved fresh every time the command runs, so member counts and similar figures are always current rather than a snapshot from when the command was created. See the Variables reference on the Info tab, or this module's own list below, for every {group.key} usable in a message.

sections.heading: Built-in commands
sections.body: NEXORIA ships a small set of commands every server gets automatically, including /dashboard, /help, and /status. Built-ins are kept in the same command list so the server owner can enable/disable them and change their permission/category settings, but they cannot be deleted.
